GMB.note: Portal login for TIN registration only; no identity authentication service stated.
Document does not mention civil register or birth records.
No enrolment count or share stated.
No statement on who operates or owns the ID system.
National ID is only one accepted document for TIN registration; the register is not stated to be keyed on it.
National ID is named only as a registration document; nothing on the ID system itself.

facts.fact: The Gambia Revenue Authority brochure describes online TIN e-registration through its web portal, with an instant e-acknowledgement and a printable TIN certificate on approval.
The brochure lists customs transactions (imports and exports) among the uses of the TIN, alongside tax filing and payment.
